I will not make big changes from what has worked around me. On 12 mu, I cannot gamble. I will keep most land in the wheat-maize rotation, because that is the steady way here, and I will leave a smaller piece for cotton. I watch what nearby people do, and if a field looks hungry I would rather give a little extra fertilizer than lose grain. Water from the well helps me, so I will not let wheat miss the key water or let maize dry hard in summer. For wheat and maize, I will use the better seed people around me have been using these years. For cotton, I will keep a smaller area because it takes more watching and more spraying, but I still plant some because if the year is decent it brings cash. I do things the plain way: turn the cotton land deeper, work the grain land with rotary tillage, put enough base fertilizer in, then topdress when the crop is really growing.
